description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractEntityConditionCache that manages caching of entity conditions and associated data within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving, inserting, removing cache entries, and hooks for storing entity state changes, specifically for entity condition-based caches.

classes.name: AbstractEntityConditionCache
classes.description: An abstract cache class for entity conditions that manages cache retrieval, insertion, removal, and hooks for entity change events, utilizing concurrent maps for thread-safe cache operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache based on entity name, condition, and key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache for a specific entity, condition, and key, considering entity caching policies.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries related to a specific entity or condition.

methods.name: getConditionCache
methods.description: Fetches the cache map for a given entity and condition.

methods.name: getOrCreateConditionCache
methods.description: Ensures the existence of a cache map for a given entity and condition, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: storeHook
methods.description: Hooks to update cache entries when entities are stored or modified, with overloads to handle different scenarios.
